events.title: Platform 2026 Artist Talks
events.location: IMA Ground Floor Gallery, Fortitude Valley
events.description: Emerging artists Dean Ansell, Spencer Harvie, and Seren Wagstaff discuss their ambitious new projects featured in the IMA's annual Platform exhibition, offering insights into their work and artistic process. Exact date/time to be confirmed via registration.

events.title: Brisbane Social Geeks – Philosophy, Board Games & Intellectual Discussion
events.location: New Farm Library area & Roma Street Parklands, Brisbane
events.description: A recurring community group for intellectual discussion, philosophy, and board games. Recent sessions have explored 'What is power?' and 'How does anyone keep or lose power?', fostering thoughtful conversations and social connections.

events.title: Platform 2026 – Dean Ansell, Spencer Harvie & Seren Wagstaff
events.datetime: Tue 12 May – Sun 17 May, 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM
events.location: Institute of Modern Art (IMA), Fortitude Valley
events.description: This annual exhibition at Brisbane's credible contemporary art institution features ambitious new works by three Queensland-emerging artists: Dean Ansell, Spencer Harvie, and Seren Wagstaff, with Spencer Harvie's work exploring online subcultures, AI, and elaborate cartoon logic.

events.title: National Theatre Live: All My Sons
events.location: Palace Cinemas James St, Fortitude Valley
events.description: A screening of Arthur Miller's acclaimed play All My Sons, starring Bryan Cranston, filmed live from London's West End and directed by Ivo Van Hove, exploring themes of family, war, and the American dream.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival – VHS
events.datetime: Thu 14 May, 7:00 PM – Sun 17 May, 6:00 PM (various times)
events.location: Brisbane Powerhouse, Graffiti Room, New Farm
events.description: VHS is performed at the intimate Graffiti Room within the Brisbane Powerhouse, offering an atmospheric and immersive performance as part of the Brisbane Comedy Festival.

events.title: Genesis Owusu
events.description: Catch Genesis Owusu, one of Australia's most exciting and genre-defying artists, known for adventurous, high-energy live music, at Fortitude Music Hall.

events.title: Endless Swarm – Body Hammering Australia 2026
events.description: Scotland's powerviolence act Endless Swarm performs a sweaty underground gig at BackDock Arts, offering a deeply subcultural and intense live music experience.

events.title: Weaving is Healing – Basketry Workshop
events.description: A hands-on basketry workshop using the Figure 8 coil weave technique, held in the beautiful Mt Coot-tha Botanic Gardens. This community-oriented event is described as an immersive sharing and healing circle.

events.title: Brisbane Social and Language Exchange
events.datetime: Multiple dates this week (check Eventbrite for exact sessions)
events.description: A multicultural social mixer and language exchange for meeting new people and practising various languages like Japanese, French, German, and Spanish, welcoming students, expats, and locals alike.

events.title: Jean Barth – 'Screen Tests'
events.datetime: Tue 12 May – Sat 16 May, 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM
events.description: An exhibition by Jean Barth titled 'Screen Tests' at Milani Gallery, a respected contemporary art space known for showcasing significant Australian artists in West End.

events.title: HSBC German Film Festival 2026
events.location: Palace Cinemas James St & Fortitude Valley
events.description: The annual German Film Festival showcases the best contemporary German, Austrian, and Swiss cinema, offering a curated selection of art-house films direct from major European festivals.

events.title: Alliance Française French Film Festival
events.location: Palace Cinemas James St, Fortitude Valley
events.description: The 2026 French Film Festival brings a selection of contemporary French cinema, including the opening night film Colours of Time. Screenings run throughout the week, offering a cultural immersion in French storytelling.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival – Geraldine Hickey: A Weight Off My Chest
events.description: Catch beloved Australian stand-up comedian Geraldine Hickey as she performs her show A Weight Off My Chest as part of the Brisbane Comedy Festival at the intimate Princess Theatre.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival – Ray O'Leary: I Can See O'Leary Now The Ray Has Gone
events.description: New Zealand comedian Ray O'Leary performs his stand-up show as part of the Brisbane Comedy Festival, offering a chance to see an international act in an intimate theatre setting.

events.title: J.I.D – God Does Like World Tour
events.description: Critically acclaimed Atlanta rapper J.I.D brings his God Does Like World Tour to Fortitude Music Hall, known for his intelligent, intricate lyricism and genuine hip-hop experience.

events.title: Redlands Coast Adventure Fest
events.datetime: Fri 15 May – Sun 17 May (starts this week)
events.location: Redlands Coast (approx. 40 min from Brisbane CBD)
events.description: A free community festival featuring over 100 activities and adventures, including adrenaline-pumping experiences, hands-on activities, and interactive displays, hosted by Ranger Stacey.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival – Pete Helliar: An International Kerfuffle
events.description: High-profile Australian comedian and TV personality Pete Helliar brings his show An International Kerfuffle to the Princess Theatre for two nights as part of the Brisbane Comedy Festival.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival – Jason Leong
events.description: Malaysian comedian Jason Leong performs stand-up as part of the Brisbane Comedy Festival program at Fortitude Music Hall.

events.title: Brisbane Comedy Festival – Bron Lewis
events.description: Australian comedian Bron Lewis performs stand-up as part of the Brisbane Comedy Festival at the Princess Theatre. This show is currently sold out, but checking for returns may be possible.

events.title: Audrey Hobert – The Staircase To Stardom Tour
events.description: Audrey Hobert performs as part of her The Staircase To Stardom Tour at Fortitude Music Hall.
